## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.2.0

### Highlights
- 🇺🇦 **Ukrainian interface**: choose English or Українська in **Settings → General → Language**. A Ukrainian README is available too.
- 🎛 **Redesigned settings**: five clear sections (General, Chat, Appearance, Hotkeys, Profiles) instead of eight cramped tabs.
- 🌍 **Layouts built for any language**: long translations no longer overflow or cover other elements (waypoints, map, chat, tray menu, dialogs).
- 🛡 **Safer updates**: your `config.json`, `points.json` and `profiles.json` are backed up and verified before an update, restored automatically if something goes wrong, and the backups are removed once the app runs fine.

### Added
- Ukrainian translation (`uk.json`, 292 texts) and `docs/readme/README.uk.md`.
- Verified update backups with automatic restore and cleanup.

### Changed
- Settings: sidebar navigation, wrapping labels and checkboxes, buttons that flow onto new lines.
- Waypoints window: two-line cards, import/export buttons never cut off; category names are translatable.
- Language list shows "English name — native name" (no flag emoji).
- Shared dark theme for the tray menu and confirmation dialogs.
- Update check interval applies immediately after saving.

### Fixed
- `.update_backup` folder and `*.bak` files remaining after an update.
- Clipped buttons/labels and a lost `&` in "Map & Waypoints" menu text.

### ⚠️ Updating from v2.0.0
The v2.0.0 updater is broken. **Download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` (or the Portable build) below and replace your old exe once.** Your settings and waypoints stay untouched. From v2.1.0 on, updates install with one click.

### First launch
Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time. This is normal for free unsigned apps and is **not** a virus warning: click **More info → Run anyway** once. Details and screenshots in the [README](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map#-windows-says-protected-your-pc--is-this-a-virus) ([Українською](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map/blob/main/docs/readme/README.uk.md)).

### Files
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe`: standard build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`: portable build
- `SCUM_Chat_Translator_v2.2.0.zip`: exe + instructions

`config.json`, `points.json` and `profiles.json` are not shipped: the app creates them next to the exe on first launch.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/tankow79/scum-ui-translator-map/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
